checkpoint_float32.interpretation: Energy fractions weight tensors by squared Frobenius norm. Rank16 means up to 16 components per projection, not one global rank16 approximation. These are descriptive approximate spectra, without a population or causal inference.

runtime_bfloat16.interpretation: Energy fractions weight tensors by squared Frobenius norm. Rank16 means up to 16 components per projection, not one global rank16 approximation. These are descriptive approximate spectra, without a population or causal inference.

config.checkpoint_precision: cast stored checkpoint tensors directly to float32, then subtract
config.runtime_precision: cast each checkpoint to bfloat16, then subtract in float32

method_limits: Randomized SVD with fixed per-tensor seeds and four power iterations estimates only the leading 16 singular values. Finite-rank estimates may understate leading singular values and overstate stable rank; unresolved energy is not a resolved tail spectrum. Raw checkpoint and runtime-matched analyses use the same random seed within each tensor. Parameter spectra do not establish behavior or training intent.
